title: Junta Property of a Reindexed Restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f\colon\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $J$ and $P$ be sets of coordinates, let $z$ assign a sign to every coordinate in $P$, and let $k$ be a natural number. If $|J|\le k$ and $f$ depends only on the coordinates in $J$, then the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing the coordinates in $P$ to $z$ and reindexing the remaining coordinates is a $k$-junta.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$J,P$ are finite sets of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$
